source_files.stp_checklist: CHECK LIST FOR LAC MEETINGS - STP (2).md

calculation_rules.formula_source: The selected calculation basis uses the approved commercial input and the NPV formula demonstrated in the workbook. Case-specific workbook values are prefilled only after an exact plot match.
calculation_rules.structure_area_rule: When structure is selected, the verified structure area is used as the chargeable area. Otherwise chargeable area equals plot area multiplied by approved FSI.
calculation_rules.service_charge_rule: Service charge is displayed separately from rent/upfront consideration because the supplied workbook records it as separately payable; it is not added to the NPV without an approved case formula.

form_fields.label: Tender method
form_fields.source_note: Choose the approved commercial method for this proposal.

form_fields.label: Agreement type
form_fields.source_note: Choose exactly one approved agreement type.

form_fields.label: Structure applicable
form_fields.source_note: Select only when an approved/verified structure area must be used as the chargeable area.

form_fields.label: Verified structure area (sq. m)
form_fields.source_note: Required when structure is selected; it replaces plot-area × FSI in the calculation.

form_fields.label: Consideration calculation
form_fields.source_note: Choose whether this proposal is calculated as annual rent or discounted upfront premium.

form_fields.label: Calculation workbook scenario
form_fields.source_note: Shown only when an exact selected-plot match exists in the supplied workbook. Select a sheet to prefill its case-specific values.

form_fields.label: G-Sec rate effective date
form_fields.source_note: Record the effective date of the approved G-Sec/discount rate. Required for upfront premium calculations.

form_fields.label: G-Sec / discount rate (%)
form_fields.source_note: Enter the approved G-Sec/discount rate applicable on the recorded effective date.

form_fields.label: Service charge applicable
form_fields.source_note: Select when an approved service charge applies. It is calculated and shown separately.

form_fields.label: Service charge (INR per sq. m per month)
form_fields.source_note: Enter only the approved service-charge rate; it is not inferred from a different workbook case.

form_fields.label: Plot area (sq. m)
form_fields.source_note: Prefilled from the selected vacant-plot record when available; verify by joint survey.

form_fields.label: Proposed use
form_fields.source_note: Enter the use approved for this proposal.

form_fields.label: Lease / licence period (years)
form_fields.source_note: Enter the approved period. It is required for an upfront premium calculation.

form_fields.label: Approved FSI
form_fields.source_note: Required when no verified structure area is used; it is not inferred from the CSV.

form_fields.label: Approved monthly SoR / reserve rate (INR per sq. m)
form_fields.source_note: Required for Tender method from an approved SoR/LAC record; it is not inferred from historic source rows.

form_fields.label: Approved nominal rent (INR per sq. m per year)
form_fields.source_note: Required for Nominal method. Enter the approved case-specific rate; no nominal rate is assumed.

form_fields.label: Annual escalation (%)
form_fields.source_note: Enter the escalation percentage approved for this proposal.

form_fields.label: GST (%)
form_fields.source_note: Enter the applicable approved GST rate for the upfront premium.
